_comment: Test data for ysocial-upstream-check.test.mjs. All release names and bodies are invented. 'upstream_wording' uses tags and dates of real upstream releases (public version metadata, 17.10.2026) and invented bodies that follow the upstream wording: notices like 'upgrade immediately' with an advisory ID, a '## Security' section, plain changelogs. Handles, PR links and advisory IDs are invented (@beispiel-person, example.invalid, PSA-2099-..., GHSA-beis-...). 'synthetic' holds invented releases that do not exist.
